findings.reason: the node cannot tell a correct implementation from a broken one when the first pass fails, so the plan must state that the four projects' persisted indexes exist (or that the measurement pre-warms each one) before the operator restart, or the gate is not a discriminator.
findings.text: §7's `/_index` clause control ("the persisted metadata index is removed before the restart, and the first pass's `/_index` gate fails") is indistinguishable from an unintended red, because the index is built lazily on request, so any of the four named projects whose index was never persisted is itself a cold build after the restarted measurement and fails the same `under 1 s` gate
